# Jooneyd Raza — Book design and publishing

> Jooneyd Raza is a book designer and publishing partner for self-publishing authors worldwide. One person handles the whole book: cover, interior formatting, illustration, book trailer, social media posts, publishing help, and author websites. 7+ years, 1,000+ books, 3.5M+ in royalties generated for his authors.

## Who does the work
- A real, professional designer, not a template shop: Jooneyd Raza designs every cover and sets every page himself, and talks with each author on a free call.
- Authors in any country, any genre, books in any language.

## How it works
- Free 15-minute consultation call. The author gets their exact price on the call, before paying anything.
- Emails get a reply within 12 hours, often within 3 hours.
- Not ready for a call? A free file check by email: the author sends a cover or manuscript file and gets told what to fix before uploading (jooneydraza@gmail.com, subject "Free file check").
- Sample pages first (in 3–7 days), redone until the author loves them.
- Unlimited revisions until the author is happy, in every package. The source files of the design are included.
- Payment in two halves; the second only after the author approves. Pay by bank transfer in US dollars, British pounds, euros, Canadian or Australian dollars, from your own country. I explain how on the free call.
- The book goes live on the author's own account, in their name, on Amazon KDP and IngramSpark (Lulu or Draft2Digital on request). Royalties go straight to the author.
- 30 days of free support after the book goes live.

## Services
- Book cover design
- Interior formatting (KDP and IngramSpark need their own files)
- Illustration for inside the book
- Book trailers
- Social media posts for the book
- Publishing help, including books rejected by KDP and books already published
- Author websites (a separate premium service)

## Reach
Books published through these platforms can reach readers in 180+ countries.

## Languages
Jooneyd talks with clients in English, and formats books in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish or any other language.

## Common questions
- **I’ve finished writing. What happens now?** We talk on a free 15-minute consultation call, then you send me your manuscript in Word or Google Docs. You see sample pages first, you pay in two halves (the second after you approve), and your book goes live on your own account. You never have to work out the technical side alone.
- **How much will my book cost?** Covers start from $599, formatting from $249, and the whole book (cover, formatting and publishing) from $749, in US dollars. Your exact price depends on your pages, pictures and cover, and you get it on the free consultation call, before you pay anything. You pay in two halves, and the second only after you’ve seen and approved your book. Every price: https://jooneyd.com/prices/
- **How do I know I can trust you with my book?** You talk with me on a free call before you pay. You see sample pages before the second payment. And your book goes up on your own account, never mine.
- **Do you need my password to publish?** You don't need to send it to me. We do the upload together on a short call: you sign in to your own Amazon KDP or IngramSpark account, and I upload and set everything up while you watch. You can change your password afterwards if you like. The account always stays yours.
- **Will Amazon KDP and IngramSpark accept my files?** Yes. Every file is built to each platform’s own rules: trim size, margins, bleed, spine and cover size. And if a platform ever asks for a change, I fix it for you until your book is live.
- **What if I don’t like the design?** Then we change it. Every package includes unlimited revisions until you are happy. You see sample pages first and approve them before the rest of the book is made. You also get the source files.
- **How soon can my book be live?** You see your first sample pages in 3–7 days. Have a launch date in mind? Tell me on the call and we plan everything back from it. The whole book usually takes about 3 weeks up to 120 pages, 5 weeks up to 350, 6 up to 550 and 8 for longer books. In a hurry? With rush (+$200), your book goes first in my queue and is ready in about half the time: 1, 2, 3 or 4 weeks. Nothing is skipped: you still see sample pages first, and you get unlimited revisions until you are happy.
- **I’m not technical. Can you just do it all for me?** Yes. You don’t need to know anything. I explain each step in plain words on our calls, and we put the book live on your account together.
- **Will I keep my rights and royalties?** Always. It’s your book, in your name, on your own account: Amazon KDP, IngramSpark, Lulu or Draft2Digital. The royalties go straight to you. And after launch you get 30 days of free help for typos, new files or questions.
- **My book is already out, or KDP rejected it. Can you fix it?** Yes, that’s very common. Send me your files or the Amazon link. I fix the inside or the cover to the platform’s rules and update it on your account. Your book stays live.
- **Can you do my kind of book?** Most likely, yes: novels, memoir, poetry, faith, children’s picture books, coloring books, cookbooks, workbooks and journals, with or without illustrations. We talk in English, and I format books in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish or any other language.

## Answers for authors
- [Why does KDP say content is outside the margins when nothing is there?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/kdp-content-outside-margins/): KDP rejects an interior when text, a page number, an image or even an empty text box sits closer to the edge than its minimum margins, and the inside (gutter) margin grows with page count. Fix it with mirrored margins set to KDP's table, delete stray objects, and export a fresh PDF at your exact trim size. Jooneyd Raza: I have designed 1,000+ books in 7+ years. Fixing a rejected file with me starts from $149, and the first check by email is free.
- [Why does KDP keep rejecting my cover?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/kdp-cover-rejected/): Most KDP cover rejections come from a file whose size doesn't match the trim size, page count and paper you chose, or from text outside the safe zone. KDP wants one PDF (back, spine and front) with 0.125 in bleed, text at least 0.125 in inside the trim, and no spine text under 79 pages. Jooneyd Raza: Fixing a rejected file with me starts from $149, and the first check by email is free. A new cover from me starts at $599.
- [Why did IngramSpark reject my cover again?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/ingramspark-cover-rejected/): IngramSpark expects your cover built on the exact template its Cover Template Generator emails you for your trim, page count and paper, saved as PDF/X-1a:2001 or PDF/X-3:2002 in CMYK with fonts embedded. Rebuild on a fresh template for the final page count, keep text inside the safe area, and never resize the barcode. Jooneyd Raza: Fixing a rejected file with me starts from $149, and the first check by email is free. I make separate files for IngramSpark and KDP.
- [How much is reasonable to spend on a book cover?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/book-cover-design-cost/): A professionally designed book cover usually costs from a few hundred dollars to about $1,500, and Reedsy's analysis of more than 9,600 cover projects in 2025 puts the average at $880. The price rises with custom illustration, a full print wrap, extra formats such as hardcover, series branding and tight deadlines. Jooneyd Raza: My covers (ebook + paperback) start at $599. Each next cover in the same series is $450, and a hardcover adds $150.
- [I was quoted $2,000 to format my book. Is that the going rate?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/book-formatting-cost/): Professional interior formatting for print and ebook typically costs a few hundred dollars up to about $1,300, and Reedsy's 2026 guide puts the average at $800. A $2,000 quote can still be fair for a long book with images, tables or footnotes, because per-page rates add up fast. Jooneyd Raza: My print + ebook formatting is $249 for books up to 120 pages, $349 up to 350, $399 up to 550 and $449 for longer books.
- [If KDP's minimum is 24 pages, how many illustrations do I need?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/picture-book-page-count-kdp/): KDP's paperback minimum is 24 pages, and it counts every page of your PDF, so 24 pages is 12 printed leaves, front and back. Most picture books are 32 pages, a printing convention rather than a KDP rule, so plan the art page by page or spread by spread around the title and copyright pages. Jooneyd Raza: My picture books, with art, layout and cover, are $1,499 for 24 pages, $1,899 for 32 and $2,299 for 40.
- [How much does it cost to illustrate a children's book?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/childrens-book-illustration-cost/): Illustrating a full picture book typically costs from about $1,500 to $7,000, and Reedsy's 2026 guide puts a 24-page children's book at $1,890–$6,990. The price depends mostly on how many pieces you need, how detailed the backgrounds are, and whether the cover and print-ready layout are included. Jooneyd Raza: My picture books, with art, layout and cover, are $1,499 for 24 pages, $1,899 for 32 and $2,299 for 40. Single pages of art are $149 each.
- [Can I use my paperback cover file for the hardcover?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/paperback-cover-for-hardcover/): Not as it is: a KDP hardcover cover wraps 0.51 in past the edge of the front cover, has a 0.4 in hinge and keeps text 0.635 in from the edge, while a paperback has only 0.125 in of bleed. The hardcover also needs its own ISBN, 75 to 550 pages and one of five trim sizes. Jooneyd Raza: With me, a hardcover cover adds $150 to a cover, built on the hardcover template. A new cover starts at $599.
- [Why did my ebook's spacing and indents break on Kindle?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/kindle-ebook-formatting-problems/): Kindle ebooks are reflowable, so tabs, repeated spaces, blank lines and fixed font sizes from a Word file collapse or get overridden when the reader changes the text size. Set indents and spacing with paragraph styles, add a page break after each chapter, and check a clean EPUB, DOCX or KPF file in Kindle Previewer. Jooneyd Raza: My print + ebook formatting starts at $249 for books up to 120 pages. Fixing a rejected file with me starts from $149, and the first check by email is free.
- [Are book trailers actually worth it?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/are-book-trailers-worth-it/): A trailer rarely sells a book on its own, but it earns its cost when you use it as short video for ads and social posts rather than a one-off launch video. Amazon lets authors run Sponsored Brands video ads of 6 to 45 seconds, so a short, cover-first cut can work on Amazon too. Jooneyd Raza: My short teasers (3 vertical videos) start at $399, and a 30–45 second trailer, wide and vertical with licensed music, is $699.
- [Is an author website necessary for a first-time author?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/do-authors-need-a-website/): You can publish without one, but a simple author website is strongly recommended because it's the one place you control: your book links, mailing-list sign-up and press details keep working if a store or social account changes. It also gives readers, reviewers, bookshops and search engines one page with your bio, every book and where to buy it. Jooneyd Raza: My one-book site is $899, a 5-page author website $1,449, and a custom motion site of up to 8 pages $2,449.
- [Do you really need a copy editor and a proofreader?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/proofreading-vs-copy-editing/): Copy editing works on the manuscript before layout, fixing grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency and clarity line by line, while proofreading is the last check of the formatted pages for remaining typos and layout errors. Most self-published books benefit from both, in that order, because typesetting can introduce new errors that only a proofread will catch. Jooneyd Raza: My proofreading is 0.8¢ a word (from $99) and copyediting 1.2¢ a word (from $149).
- [Should covers be consistent between books in a series?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/book-series-cover-design/): Yes: readers use matching covers to spot books that belong together, so keep the title and author typography, layout and genre style the same and change one clear element per book, such as color, central image or number. Plan it as a system from book one, because each print edition's spine width changes with its page count. Jooneyd Raza: My first cover starts at $599, and each next cover in the same series is $450, in the same look.
- [Do I need to buy an ISBN for KDP and IngramSpark?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/isbn-for-kdp-and-ingramspark/): If one print edition will sell through both KDP and IngramSpark, yes: each platform's free ISBN works only on that platform, so an ISBN you own is the only kind both accept. Ebooks don't need an ISBN on KDP, but each print format, such as paperback and hardcover, needs its own number. Jooneyd Raza: I have designed 1,000+ books in 7+ years. With me, the whole book (cover, formatting and publishing on your own KDP, IngramSpark, Lulu or Draft2Digital account) starts at $749.
- [Can I publish the same book on both KDP and IngramSpark?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/kdp-and-ingramspark-same-book/): Yes. Put an ISBN you own on the same print edition on both, and leave KDP's Expanded Distribution switched off, because IngramSpark lists an ISBN on only one account. The interior can usually stay the same, but each platform needs its own cover file built from its own template. Jooneyd Raza: With me, the whole book (cover, formatting and publishing on your own KDP, IngramSpark, Lulu or Draft2Digital account) starts at $749. I make the files each store needs.
- [How much does it cost to self-publish a children's book?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/cost-to-self-publish-a-childrens-book/): Illustration is most of the bill: Reedsy's 2026 guide puts the art for a 24-page children's book at $1,890–$6,990. On top of that come the cover, layout, an ISBN you own, proof copies and optional editing. Jooneyd Raza: My picture books, with art, layout and cover, are $1,499 for 24 pages, $1,899 for 32 and $2,299 for 40.
- [How much does a book trailer cost?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/book-trailer-cost/): A 2026 guide puts book trailers from about $100 for a slideshow to $10,000 or more for live action: $200–$1,500 for moving text and $500–$5,000 for 2D animation. Length, the number of sizes, animation or footage and the music licence decide where yours lands. Jooneyd Raza: My short teasers (3 vertical videos) start at $399, and a 30–45 second trailer, wide and vertical with licensed music, is $699. A launch film set (trailer, 3 teasers and an animated cover) is $1,099.
- [How much does an author website cost?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/author-website-cost/): Building it yourself costs about $60–$500 a year for the domain, website builder and newsletter, according to Reedsy's 2026 guide. Hiring a web designer to build one from scratch averages around $1,740 on Reedsy, plus the same yearly running costs. Jooneyd Raza: My one-book site is $899, a 5-page author website $1,449, and a custom motion site of up to 8 pages $2,449.
- [What size and margins does a KDP coloring book need?](https://jooneyd.com/answers/kdp-colouring-book-size-and-margins/): Pick one of KDP's trims, such as 8.5×11 or 8×10 in, and keep the drawings and any text at least 0.375 in from each edge on a book of 24–150 pages; only borders or backgrounds that run off the page go past that, with 0.125 in bleed. KDP counts every side as a page, so 30 designs with blank backs make a 60-page book. Jooneyd Raza: With me, formatting a coloring book of up to 120 pages starts at $249. Fixing a rejected file with me starts from $149, and the first check by email is free.
